formal_properties.summary: No formal theorem about the molecular trajectory or biological transfer

numerical_fidelity.summary: Reference derivative/sign control, paired1fs/0.5fs50fsNVE and same-systemCPU/CUDAforce+energy parity passed

empirical_validation.summary: No held-out molecular dynamics or mechanical assay; crystal coordinates are starting input, not independent validation
empirical_validation.scope: Synthetic motif only, not fish tissue calibration

parameter_coverage.summary: Three velocity/thermostat seeds at one assumed300K/0.1M condition, sharing one structure and Hamiltonian
parameter_coverage.scope: Descriptive seed spread; no native fish population or force-field coverage

cross_scale_transfer.summary: Molecular chain distance cannot set fin EI without fibril/tissue constitutive calibration
cross_scale_transfer.scope: Synthetic motif only, not fish tissue calibration

ensemble_robustness.summary: No predeclared functional success predicate; three actual seed trajectories are not a biological-success fraction
ensemble_robustness.scope: Synthetic motif only, not fish tissue calibration

region_membership: No anatomically calibrated region mapping for this synthetic motif
